name: std::hash<std::error_condition>
intro: The template specialization of std::hash for std::error_condition allows users to obtain hashes of objects of type std::error_condition.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Represent invalid_argument, inspect it, copy it, and clear it. Error messages depend on the implementation.
